mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (chat_id, sender_id, message_type, content, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, FALSE, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, chat_id, sender_id, message_type, content, is_deleted, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT message_id, chat_id, sender_id, message_type, content, is_deleted, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE chat_id = #{chatId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
